sensor: Thermal: 12 um 384x288 uncooled focal plane array, 8-14 um, NETD <= 50 mK; optical: 1/2.8" CMOS
features: thermal + optical bi-spectrum network speed dome
optical channel: 4MP (2560x1440) with 32x optical zoom (4.8-154mm, F1.65-F4.70)
thermal detector: 384x288, 12 um, 25mm F1.0 lens (10.5 x 7.9 FOV)
thermal palettes: black hot, white hot, rainbow, iron oxide red
temperature measurement -20 to 150 C (+/-8 C or 8%), 10 point/line/area rules, high/low temperature alarm
dynamic fire detection, up to 10 fire points
line crossing, region intrusion/entrance/exit, target counting, face detection (optical)
release_notes: Specs per official UNICAM datasheet (UC-P632AE2.pdf, image-only). Resolution field records the thermal module; optical channel is 4MP. Thermal HxV FOV 10.5 x 7.9; optical H 59.38-2.28. NETD given as <35 mK on the cover but <=50 mK in the spec table. Power row says DC24V or PoE++ (802.3bt) (avg 24W, max 35W) while a PoE row says IEEE802.3af.

frigate.notes: UNICAM does not publish the RTSP path; discover the stream via ONVIF. Default HTTP/ONVIF port 80, RTSP port 554.

blue_iris.notes: Add as a generic ONVIF camera.
